caption:
Booking a ₹7,600 hotel room this Diwali: did you know ₹1,368 of the bill is GST?

Hotel rooms priced at or below ₹7,500 a night pay 5% GST: ₹375 on a ₹7,500 room.
Above ₹7,500 the rate jumps to 18%, on the whole tariff: ₹1,368 on ₹7,600.
So a room just ₹100 dearer costs ₹1,093 more a night: ₹8,968 vs ₹7,875. Over a 3-night trip that's ₹3,279.

Have you ever paid more in GST than the room upgrade itself?

Sources: a tax-compliance site's 2026 hotel GST guide and a brokerage's news explainer on the September 2025 GST rate change; the ₹ figures are our own arithmetic.
